intro: Lesotho is the only country in the world entirely above 1,000 m.

chapters.title: Mountains
text: Thabana Ntlenyana, 3,482 m, is the highest peak in southern Africa. Maletsunyane Falls drops about 190 m. Afriski is one of Africa's few ski resorts.

chapters.title: Water
text: The Lesotho Highlands Water Project sends water to South Africa through tunnels.
